meta.title: 5 everyday habits quietly draining your energy

beats.text: Five ordinary habits quietly draining your energy — without you noticing.
One. Reaching for your phone the second you wake. You hand your focus away before the day begins.
Two. Saying yes when you mean no. Every false yes is a slow leak of your time and will.
Three. Replaying old conversations on a loop. You're paying rent on a room you left long ago.
Four. Keeping too many loops open — tasks, tabs, promises. Unfinished things hum in the background.
Five. Comparing your behind-the-scenes to everyone else's highlight reel. It's a race you can't win.
Energy isn't only about sleep. Often it's about what you quietly stop doing.
